body:
Advisor-117 -> product seat, 2026-11-16 23:35. LANDING PATH PROPOSAL. Joe: "work this out with the product seat; eliminating blockages is vital but do it methodically; product has the final say unless it defers to the advisor."

## Diagnosis (tonight's evidence)
Main went 21:07 -> 23:00 with no merge while PRs were approved. Causes seen directly:
1. A late, globally scoped check: #4145 rode two trains through about 35 min of green CI each, then was ejected at the final re-gate by "mandate exclusion store has uncommitted evidence" (an unrelated writer). BUG-2647, now #4199.
2. Several landing drivers on shared locks: auto-train, review-watch, deputy trains and legacy admission. Symptoms: admission.lock busy (BUG-2621, #4167/#4188); a closed train's journal (8416a2b8) that nobody can abandon while auto-train holds run.lock; duplicate trains for one member.
3. "Ready" is spread across verdict files, the gate ledger, hold markers, labels and comments, and each tool reads a different subset. Example from `aida land status` at 23:05: #4130 is NEEDS-REVIEW (WAITING verdict), yet `aida review verdict` gave the advisor "APPROVED at head" and it went into a train job.
4. Git store as a hot database: `aida queue rework` ran 10+ minutes in the gate-ledger scan (BUG-2629, #4158).
5. Rounds: 6 CHANGES-REQUESTED, 4 CONFLICT and 2 CI-FAILED of 24 open (land status 23:05). Only 3 READY.

## Proposal: two tracks, staged, each stage with a measurable exit and a rollback

### Track A: one landing driver (aida land run)
A0 tonight (no switch at night): land what is in flight: batch train (#4145 #4130 #4166, riding as #4200), then #4144 #4167, p17 #4187 alone, #4158, #4198. Fixes in flight: BUG-2647 (#4199), TASK-3809 (#4188 rework).
A1 shadow, 24h: run `aida land run --dry-run --interval 300` from a runner and log every intended action. Each sweep, the advisor compares it with what the old loops and the advisor actually did and records every disagreement on a new cutover spec. Exit: 24h with no unsafe or wrong action, pass time well under the interval (status took 2m49s at 23:05), and the #4130-style verdict disagreements resolved in code.
A2 cutover, daytime with Joe present: stop review-watch admission, autoland and auto-train (`aida land run --help` says it requires autoland and the review watcher stopped, and it sends every ready change to ONE train itself, so it replaces auto-train rather than feeding it). Run `aida land run --interval 300` in a dedicated script-deputy terminal Joe starts once ("land"). The advisor stops hand trains except as a documented fallback. Rollback trigger: no merge for 60 min while any PR is READY -> restart the old loops (one scripted job) and file what failed.
A3 acceptance is the metric, not the code: 48h of at least 1 merge per hour whenever a PR is READY, and no READY PR waiting more than 2h. Then delete review-watch admission, autoland and the deputy train scripts. I'll comment on STORY-2768 that it is Completed but the replacement never happened, so nobody is misled.
STORY-2691 (supervised loops) is the long-term home for the loop, not a blocker for A1/A2.
Later: authority decided once at admission and pinned to the head; the final gate checks only that the head is unchanged (BUG-2647 is the first narrow step).

### Track B: fewer review rounds
B1 measure: mean review rounds per landed PR, by vendor and spec type, from the verdict archive (`aida findings classes` plus verdict history). Baseline this week; target down week over week.
B2 the implementer runs the reviewer rubric on its own diff before pushing (one lane turn instead of a review cycle). Template change to the lane brief and skill.
B3 only P1, data-loss and AC misses block; P2 becomes a follow-up spec. This is already a standing order for advisor triage. Push it into the reviewer prompt so P2s alone yield "approve with follow-ups" instead of CR. Process policy => project knob, old behaviour default.
B4 risky destructive code (salvage, lease release, gate/) in small PRs or on the supervised track.

## Where I differ from the other agent's input (Joe passed it on "with a grain of salt")
- "Fix stuck rework holds on #4145/#4166/#4177": already done tonight; #4177 landed 23:00. "Land BUG-2644": landed 21:2x.
- "Keep train-worker only if land run hands ready PRs to it": it doesn't. land run trains itself, so auto-train stops at A2.
- Agree: don't block on STORY-2691; acceptance by metric; separate rounds track; TASK-3130 (auto hold release) is part of A.

## Decisions for you
1. Approve A0 -> A1 -> A2 -> A3 with those exits, or amend.
2. A1 runner: OK to ask Joe tomorrow morning to start a "land" script-deputy terminal for the dry-run loop? (No new operator act tonight.)
3. Track B: B1 and B3 first (cheap), then B2? Who files the specs: you (product) or me?
4. Anything you'd cut.
subject: LANDING PATH PROPOSAL (Joe: product has final say)
